landing.hero.badge: Accounts receivable automation for small businesses
landing.hero.subtitle: Payalarm moves your payments from accepted quote to deposit, progress invoices and final payment — with automated reminders in between. Work smarter, not harder.
landing.hero.beta: Now in beta – become one of our first customers.
landing.workflow.title: Get Paid From Deposit to Final Payment
landing.workflow.subtitle: One continuous, automated payment journey. Payalarm turns your project into a predictable cash flow machine.
landing.workflow.step1.title: Quote accepted
landing.workflow.step1.desc: Send a professional quote. Your customer accepts it with one click and the deposit invoice is created automatically.
landing.workflow.step2.title: Deposit collected
landing.workflow.step2.desc: Your customer pays the deposit securely. Funds arrive in your account and the project is kicked off.
landing.workflow.step3.title: Progress invoices
landing.workflow.step3.desc: As project phases complete, progress invoices are issued automatically — always with the right amount.
landing.workflow.step4.title: Automated reminders
landing.workflow.step4.desc: Polite reminders go out automatically before and after due dates. Escalating dunning kicks in only if needed.
landing.workflow.step5.title: Final payment
landing.workflow.step5.desc: The final invoice closes the project. Cash flow stays healthy — from deposit to final payment.
landing.workflow.panel.reminderBody: Friendly reminder: invoice INV-2026-0081 is due in 2 days.
landing.portals.title: Three portals. One system.
landing.portals.subtitle: Everyone involved in the payment journey gets a tailored workspace.
landing.portals.business.title: For business owners & finance teams
landing.portals.business.desc: Manage customers, quotes, deposits, project phases, progress invoices and automated dunning from one dashboard.
landing.portals.customer.title: For your customers
landing.portals.customer.desc: No login needed: your customer opens the link, sees quote or invoice and pays in two clicks.
landing.portals.admin.title: For administrators
landing.portals.admin.desc: Full control over users, companies, roles, plans, subscriptions and the whole payment automation platform.
landing.features.title: Everything you need to get paid
landing.features.subtitle: From the first quote to the final payment — automated, transparent and on time.
landing.features.f1.title: Smart quotes
landing.features.f1.desc: Professional quotes with line items, deposit percentages and automatic deposit invoicing on acceptance.
landing.features.f2.title: Deposit collection
landing.features.f2.desc: Collect deposits before work begins and reduce your risk on every new project.
landing.features.f3.title: Phase-based progress invoicing
landing.features.f3.desc: Define project phases and let Payalarm issue progress invoices as each milestone is completed.
landing.features.f4.title: Automated payment reminders
landing.features.f4.desc: Friendly reminders before due dates, escalating dunning after. You set the cadence, Payalarm sends the mail.
landing.features.f5.title: Dunning escalation
landing.features.f5.desc: Structured dunning levels with templates in your customer's language. Escalate automatically, stay professional.
landing.features.f6.title: Receivables dashboard
landing.features.f6.desc: Outstanding balances, aging, cash flow and days-sales-outstanding — all in real time.
landing.features.f7.title: Customer portal
landing.features.f7.desc: Your customers get a branded portal to accept quotes, track projects and pay invoices securely.
landing.features.f8.title: Bilingual by default
landing.features.f8.desc: Every invoice, reminder and page in English and German. Switch languages at any time — it's remembered.
landing.beta.title: Now in beta
landing.beta.subtitle: We are building Payalarm together with our first customers. Join them, try it for free, and help us perfect the product.
landing.diff.title: Not just another accounting tool
landing.diff.subtitle: Lexoffice, sevDesk and FastBill do accounting — dunning is just a side feature there. Payalarm is specialized on one single journey: from deposit to final payment.
landing.diff.p1: From accepted quote to the last payment — one continuous, automated payment flow.
landing.diff.p2: Deposit, progress and final invoices are created automatically — tax-correct (§14 UStG).
landing.diff.p3: Customers pay via magic link — no account, no app, no login.
landing.diff.p4: Reminders and dunning escalation are core functionality, not an add-on.
landing.diff.row3: Customer portal optional, often with login

landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Payalarm.
landing.faq.q1: How does the 14-day free trial work?
landing.faq.a1: Sign up in under a minute and get full access to the Professional plan for 14 days. No credit card required. When the trial ends you can choose a plan or downgrade to the free tier.
landing.faq.q2: Can I switch plans at any time?
landing.faq.a2: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade any time. Upgrades are prorated automatically, downgrades take effect at the end of the billing period.
landing.faq.a3: You define the schedule — e.g. a reminder 3 days before due date, then on day 1 and day 7 after. Payalarm sends polite emails in your customer's language and escalates to dunning levels only when an invoice stays unpaid.
landing.faq.q4: What payment methods can my customers use?
landing.faq.a4: Customers pay directly via their personal link by card or SEPA (GiroCode) — whichever methods you enable.
landing.faq.a5: Yes. All data is stored in a managed, encrypted database with row-level security. Roles and permissions control exactly who can see what.
landing.faq.q6: Can I use Payalarm in German and English?
landing.faq.a6: Yes. The whole application — navigation, invoices, reminders, portal and notifications — is fully bilingual. Switch any time and your choice is remembered.
landing.footer.tagline: Automated accounts receivable for modern small businesses.
